incidents.name: SheepFarm register/addGems input validation
incidents.notes: SheepFarm's register()/addGems() credit gems without validating the caller's actual BNB deposit, so the attacker minted gems for free and repeatedly withdrew the farm's BNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: SheepFarm 0x4726010da871f4b57b5031E3EA48Bde961F122aA created 2022-11-09T10:38:06Z by 0x3f99830a7f0b919a4ef1d462055255faa0bb1c72, unrelated to attack sender 0x2131c67ed7b6aa01b7aa308c71991ef5baedd049; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (SheepFarm_exp and SheepFarm2_exp) for the same incident; one row is recorded. Loss verified onchain: the farm's BNB balance fell from 935.46 BNB at block 23088155 to zero by block 23095000 and the attacker EOA went from 0.0896 BNB to 261.948 BNB, a net 261.8586 BNB; 261.8586 BNB x $275.10 at incidentTimestamp 1668550412 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $72,038.
